name: afterlaunch-skills
description: A founder's content loop as agent skills, from the AfterLaunch team. Seven skills that take you from nothing to something posted: write the context file every skill reads, farm ideas from anything you read, calibrate your voice by forced choice, draft three hooks and a post per platform, strip the machine tells, work Reddit inside each subreddit's own rules without ever posting, and keep the session's effort when the terminal closes. Free and standalone; connecting AfterLaunch adds one shared board and a record that outlives the session.
